profile.description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550B parameter (55B activated) open reasoning model built for long-running autonomous agents handling orchestration and complex tasks across coding, deep research, and enterprise workflows. Its hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE architecture combines Latent MoE — which calls 4 experts at the inference cost of 1 — with Multi-Token Prediction for reduced generation time on long sequences, and Token Budget support for optimal accuracy with minimum reasoning token output. The model supports a 1M token context window and is fully open under the NVIDIA Open Model License with open weights, training data, and recipes.
